source_note: Originally datamined from RSDWArchive build 1.0.2.0 (Content/Maps/World/L_World.json: BP_MapRegion_C actors for fog bits, GameplayObjectRegistry.Landmarks for Sanguine Urns and kebbit burrows; Art/UI/Map/T_WorldMapRegions.png for sub-region lookup), then verified against an installed copy of the game (see install_check). Area gating from datamined quest flows plus the Dragonwilds wiki (paraphrased). 'shrines' are the save's Progress.ShrinesUnlocked list = Sanguine Urns (health shrines: each permanently adds +10 max health; NOT fast-travel points). Kebbit burrows are Agility shortcuts, discovered within 10 m (Progress.KebbitBurrowsFound) and dug (Progress.KebbitBurrowsActivated). fog bit N = MapRegion RegionID N in GameProgress.RevealedFog.RevealedRegionsBitmap. See docs/research/map_points.md.

confirmed_from_install: fog_bits: one BP_MapRegion_C per RegionID 1-31 in /Game/Maps/World/L_World (no region 0); every region_name and area matches
shrines: all 21 ids are landmark-registry entries of category 6 (Sanguine Urn) in /Game/Maps/World/L_World; none missing, none extra
kebbit_burrows: all 19 ids are landmark-registry entries of category 8 in /Game/Maps/World/L_World; none missing, none extra; every area matches the entry's Agility.KebbitBurrow.Region.* tag
not_confirmed_from_install: the sub-region part of shrine/burrow names (from the map texture and region splines, RSDWArchive research)
areas gating (gated_by_quest, gate_note: quest-flow research on RSDWArchive data and the wiki)

fog_bits.region_name: (no map region; always set by the game - keep it)

areas.name: Brynmoor
areas.gate_note: Starting area; open from a new character.

areas.name: Ghornfell
areas.gate_note: Act 1 open-world area next to Brynmoor; no quest door found in the flows or wiki. Entering Fractured Plains (bit 4) fires QuestFlow.Entry.DragonSlayer.GhornfellTriggerEntry, which advances Dragon Slayer ('Venture into Ghornfell') but does not gate entry.

areas.name: Fellhollow
areas.gate_note: Withering Heights. Wiki (dev quote): Dragon Slayer complete and Withering Heights started. The WH Beat1 flow sets objective 'UnlockGate' and reveals EnterDeathsDomainTarget (the necromantic door near Ashien's Watch); Beat2 sets HasTriggeredFHTPVolume when you pass into Fellhollow. The door's own check was not traced. Bit 15 (Forgotten Temple, internally Death's Domain) is reached during WH.

areas.name: Dowdun Reach
areas.gate_note: Black Knight's Fortress, objective DR_Main_Objective_0 ('Speak to Cathan at the eastern gates'). Traced in QF_DR_MainQuest_Entry, entry QuestFlow.Entry.BlackKnightsFortress.EnterDRDoor: if the prerequisite quest is not Complete the gatehouse shows 'DoorToDowdun_NotFinishedWitheringH'; otherwise, if BKF is not yet given, the door itself gives BKF (RecievedDRQuestFromDeath, DR_Main_Objective_0) and teleports you in; if BKF is given or complete it just teleports. So the real prerequisite is Withering Heights Complete, and BKF is given at the latest on first use of the gatehouse. Entering any DR region then fires RegionEntry -> DR_Main_Objective_1.

areas.name: Umbral Sands
areas.gate_note: Icthlarin's Little Helper, objective EnterUmS. ILH is given when BKF completes (StartQuest: Beat 1, EnterUmS, Bastion_DoorToUmS_Target revealed); going through the Umbral door in The Bastion fires TeleportedIntoUmS. Wiki: completing Black Knight's Fortress opens the door to Umbral Sands in The Bastion. The door blueprint's own check was not traced (inferred: ILH given / BKF complete). Entering Alcarrid Oasis (bit 26) fires UmS_MainQuest.TriggerExitCave.

areas.name: Scorned Wilderness
areas.gate_note: Regicide, objective AccessSW ('Gain access to the Scorned Wilderness'). Given at the ILH hand-in via MQ_ScornedWilderness.UmSLink (GiveQuest, AccessSW, SW_Door marker); using the Dragon Gate in north-west Fractured Plains then sets SpeakZilyana. Wiki: complete ILH and start Regicide. The gate's own check was not traced. The area sits in a separate coordinate space (off the main map texture); bit 30 = Rasthin's Rest hub, bit 31 = the raid zone.
